pages.title: Antibiotic
pages.text: Penicillin, drawn from mould: it stops bacteria building their walls. Use it on a contaminated Biology machine to clean it, but each dose on the same machine selects for what survives it, so the n-th works only one time in n; a Sterile Pack always works. Made on the Mycelium Bed.
Made in $(item)Mycelium Bed$(), $(item)Dose-Response Assay$() and $(item)Phage Lab$().$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Bsl4 Field Station chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Mycology.
